_comment: The credential vault: every secret the hub keeps, one AES-256-GCM ciphertext each under the master key in vault.key beside this file. Managed from the Credentials page and by `nhub vault`; never edited by hand.
_comment_fields: Each entry under secrets is keyed by a panel-assigned uuid4 hex id. name, kind, meta and created_at stay readable; nonce and data are base64, data sealing the kind's secret fields as JSON. kind is password | ssh_key | api_token | service_account. Underscore-prefixed keys, this placeholder entry included, are documentation and are ignored.
